name: Blue Spring State Park: winter manatee viewing from the spring-run boardwalk
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: Blue Spring State Park, 2100 W French Avenue, Orange City, FL 32763
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Separate seasonal experience inside existing entry blue-spring-orange-city (he has done the swim). Walk the spring-run boardwalk from the St. Johns River up toward the boil and watch manatees resting in the run; seasonal manatee programs run in winter. Optional two-hour narrated St. Johns River nature cruise from the park concession, and Hontoon Island is next door.
access: 8 a.m. to sunset, 365 days a year. The park frequently reaches capacity and may temporarily close, so arrive at opening on a weekday. All water activities in the spring run are closed during manatee season; viewing is from land only.

conditions.summary: Park open. Swimming season is April 1 to Nov 14, so Dec 1-8 the spring run is closed to swimming, paddling and all water activity; boardwalk/overlook manatee viewing is the experience and is at its best in this window. (source dated read 2026-11-12)

name: Potts Preserve: Oak Hammock and River primitive campgrounds (Southwest Florida Water Management District)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: 2700 Dee River Road, Inverness, FL 34453 (Oak Hammock); the River campground is at 2988 North Hooty Point, Inverness, FL 34453
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Two drive-up campgrounds in northeastern Citrus County, east of Inverness: Oak Hammock off North Dee River Road and the River campground off North Hooty Point Road, which reviewers prefer for the water access. Sites have picnic tables and fire rings. It is about 16 miles straight-line from Rainbow Springs, so it fits the Nov 23 Dunnellon night and the Nov 30 pass through Ocala. Use the right address for the site you reserved: one camper's GPS sent them to Hooty Point and their Oak Hammock gate code did not work.
access: Free permit or reservation required before arrival. Stay limit: 7 consecutive days, 30 days per calendar year All Potts campsites are closed for a hunt Nov 19-22, 2026; the next closure is Feb 4-7, 2027. Open Nov 23 - Dec 8. Portable toilets at the campgrounds; nonpotable water only at the equestrian area. The Eastern Amberwing and Holly Tree sites are hike-in only.

conditions.summary: Closed Nov 19-22 (so not available for the Nov 21 and Nov 22 nights); open from Nov 23 through the rest of the trip. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
